title: Yorulune — Tasks & Focus
shortDescription: Add tasks in seconds, see what’s next, and start a focus timer.
fullDescription:
Write a title to add a task. See what’s due and what’s coming up, or find all of your tasks in one place. Select a focus duration and start whenever you’re ready.

Use the calendar, projects and habits when you need more structure. A home-screen widget gives you quick access to tasks and the timer.

Core features work offline and require no account. There are no ads or subscriptions. Exported backups are unencrypted and may be stored by the Android document provider you choose.
